title: Decoding apathy in the middle-aged and older adults: the indirect effect of loneliness and the moderating effect of cognitive function on resilience
core_idea: Test whether resilience influences multi-dimensional apathy indirectly via loneliness, and whether cognitive function moderates that indirect pathway, in community-dwelling adults aged 50 and older.
tldr: The study examines a moderated mediation model assessing resilience, loneliness, cognitive function, and multi-dimensional apathy in adults 50+, using questionnaires and performance-based cognitive tests in a community cohort.
